items.title: DS Smith details ‘transformation’ prior to spinning off from IP
items.summary: Site closures, job cuts and strategy resets have helped productivity in the more than 18 months since being acquired by International Paper, executives said. The company split is still slated for the coming months.

items.title: ETFs Are Net Sellers of International Paper (IP) on Monday

items.title: Is International Paper (IP) Below Fair Value After Its 20% Gain?
items.summary: International Paper has delivered a 20.0% gain over the past 3 years, while recent headlines and shifting expectations around its packaging businesses keep the story in motion. With the share price at US$36.37 after mixed shorter term returns, the question now is whether that tag is well supported by what the company is generating through its sales. A 20.0% return over 3 years puts real weight on the idea that International Paper's revenue base can justify a meaningfully higher valuation...

items.title: International Paper (IP) Invests In AI Supported Frontline Communication Technology
items.summary: International Paper (NYSE: IP) has invested in Relay, a provider of AI-supported smart radios for industrial frontline teams. The partnership centers on AI-enabled communication devices designed to connect workers on production floors and in logistics operations across sites. Relay's platform is intended to capture real time frontline insights, supporting data driven decisions on safety, staffing, and throughput.
